profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Wipro Limited
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: 20+ years of expertise in product-oriented software engineering and software IT, from Development to DevOps.  Full-stack development and team leadership.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Principal Software Engineer at buildit, Wipro Digital Services, I help with business development and break-down of work.  I've also developed custom widgets for ServiceNow so that administrators can create new interfaces for the product without knowing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript like a developer.

positions.title: Sytems/Applicatiions Architect
positions.description:
As a contractor employed by Medical Science and Computing, I lead a team of 2 developers, 4 Python/Django web applications, 1 Java/Spring system, and a major batch system.  One of the applications and the batch system share an Oracle database schema with about as much PL/SQL as the Python code in the web application.

Current areas of focus within the team are (1) cross-training team members to fill in the skills matrix, (2) shrinking PL/SQL by replacing with Python, and (3) attempting to simplify the batch system and capture dependencies using a workflow engine such as airflow or prefect.

In addition to the team, I am a leader in the organization, responsible for business outcomes deliverable to the entire branch of 20 developers. Past successes include (1) a selenium web driver infrastructure allowing developers to create tests to run against on the desktop or on our own Selenium GRID, (2) several Python/Django packages used by developers to address cross cutting concerns such as authentication and logging, and (3) a utility that obtains temporary credentials from AWS.

positions.title: Consulting Software Engineer
positions.description: I wrote and maintained the query server and API, the lexer/parser for the query language, the post-process management service, the index segment merge processor and index segment upgrade tool.  I participated in the initial design and implementation of the tape manager and tape caching software.   I re-wrote and maintained the indexer for PDF documents.    I re-wrote and maintained the licensing software including a php web application to create and manage licenses.   I designed and implemented a JSON RPC midldleware that interfaced between Java and procedural C-code using multi-threaded RPC servers using the interface definition language supported by rpcgen.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on an SOAP web service modeler that ran as an Eclipse plugin.   Users of the plugin designed the web service graphically and then generated WSDL and Java code from the model.

Implemented a Java GUI that interfaced with Compaq's AlphaServer firmware to partition 8 core and 64 core into virtual machines.   Connected memory and I/O resources were also displayed.  Participated in the design of a 1U Tru64 Unix management console for the larger AlphaServer systems.

I was given an award at HP for automating the signing of Java Applet packages through an ant build system, using the corporate signing web-page.  At the time, this required adding a "task" to ant using Java source code.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Wrote and maintained embedded systems firmware for RAID disk arrays.  Wrote pseudo device drivers and pass-through SCSI daemons  on Solaris, MP RAS, and HP-UX.
